comparison.objective: Rotate an angle grinder guard to the operator-facing position and clamp it securely.
comparison.physical_skill: Release or loosen a clamp, rotate a constrained guard about the spindle, set angular orientation, and re-clamp.
comparison.success_condition: Guard reaches the prescribed protective orientation, clamp is secured, guard resists movement, and the tool is released safely.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-guard adjustment and clamping, not impact fracture at a manufactured notch or post-fracture fragment accounting.
